scope: Lake Sakakawea outfitters and access, incremental to the Devils Lake inventory
highest_priority_permission_question: Whether the Game and Fish Department and the state authorize commercial-directory reuse of license-status facts and access-site facts. The department policy page describes open-records access, the department footer reserves copyright, and neither grants that reuse. Century Code 44-04-18 was not opened.
method: Primary department, parks, and application pages were read on 2026-11-25. The handbook was re-read and still has no Lake Sakakawea roster. The 2026-28 fishing guide's Missouri River System access section was counted. The where-to-fish Lake Sakakawea address redirected to the results script, and ramp records whose location text is Sakakawea, Lake were counted. Four booking pages that name the lake were sampled, plus one vessel row. Challenge pages and an unrelated host were not turned into rows. Operator URLs, personal names, client fields, and contact details are omitted from this file. Devils Lake inventory counts are not repeated here.
